title: Crossed-module crossed braided categories
summary: For a crossed module $χ: G \to H$, we introduce the notion of $χ$-crossed braided (resp. ribbon) categories, where the categories are graded by group $G$ and carry an $H$-action. Our definition unifies and generalises several familiar notions: taking $χ= id: G \to G$ with the conjugation action recovers $G$-crossed braided categories; taking $χ: G \to \{*\}$ for abelian $G$ yields $G$-graded braided categories; taking $χ: \{*\} \to G$ leads to braided categories equipped with a $G$-action.
